_comment: Per-repo gate configuration. Two things live here: where skills and agents are found in this repo's layout, and which skills are held to the stricter rules. Adoption is a ratchet - see coverage_ratchet.py. Nineteen skills cannot adopt a seven-field frontmatter schema in one commit, and pretending otherwise produces either a red pipeline everyone learns to ignore or a gate nobody turns on.
_strict_skills: Skills held to strict_frontmatter. Add names as they are brought up to the standard; coverage_ratchet.py refuses removals.
_evals_required: Skills required to ship evaluations/baseline-evals.json with three real scenarios. Same ratchet.
_manifest_skills: Skills required to close with a manifest. Plugin skills here do not carry one yet.
